description: Composable knowledge-engineering protocols. Load only the protocols relevant to the task; do not inject the complete collection by default.

selection.signal: The request contains a false binary, ideological collision, or incompatible frames.
Facts may be stale, remembered, or detached from primary evidence.
Context from another task, user, tenant, or time period could leak into execution.
The task is broad, blocked, or failing repeatedly.
An agent run must be inspectable, replayable, or branchable.
The system proposes modifying its own tools, policies, or runtime behavior.
A behavior must survive paraphrase, compression, translation, or adversarial transformation.
Refined knowledge is ready to be handed to an execution agent.

protocols.name: Freedom Lens
protocols.summary: Escape compliance-versus-rebellion oscillation and identify the frame actually governing the decision.

protocols.name: Edge Map
protocols.summary: Preserve material contradictions and turn them into the smallest discriminating probe.

protocols.name: Reality Check
protocols.summary: Prefer current primary evidence and observable behavior over memory, narrative, or stale documentation.

protocols.name: Context Firewall
protocols.summary: Prevent unverified context from crossing task, tenant, identity, temporal, or authority boundaries.

protocols.name: Backpressure
protocols.summary: Treat repeated friction as information about a mismatched model, interface, dependency, or scope.

protocols.name: GRIT
protocols.summary: Reduce work to the smallest verifiable component, change one variable, measure, and repeat.

protocols.name: Evidence Ladder
protocols.summary: Record the transformation from request to conclusion as an append-only, inspectable evidence chain.

protocols.name: Temporal Knowledge
protocols.summary: Represent knowledge as sourced assertions with transaction time, validity intervals, supersession, and policy weights.

protocols.name: Disagreement-Preserving Convergence
protocols.summary: Map agreement and disagreement across independent responses without relabeling consensus as truth.

protocols.name: Reproducible Agent Run
protocols.summary: Capture enough execution state to replay, branch, compare, and audit an agent run.

protocols.name: Governed Self-Modification
protocols.summary: Gate runtime self-modification through validation, contract tests, atomic activation, observation, and rollback.

protocols.name: Invariant-Preserving Transformation
protocols.summary: Define behavioral invariants, transform the representation, and map where the invariant fails.

protocols.name: Execution Pack
protocols.summary: Compile refined knowledge into a bounded, attributable, verifiable handoff an agent can execute without reconstructing the task from conversation history.
